transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: Elena, Tara, thanks for the time. Elena, want to start with the goals from your side?

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: We're scaling from four clinics to eleven this year. Our intake and referral coordination breaks a little more with each new site. I need it fixed before the fall openings.

transcript.speaker: Tara Singh
transcript.text: Day to day, that's me. Every clinic has its own intake spreadsheet and referrals get lost between them weekly.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: This maps well to our coordination engine. Let me show you the multi-site routing view.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: That's the right shape. What I care about is timeline and whether this survives contact with healthcare data rules.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: We're HIPAA-compliant with a signed BAA, and eleven sites is a six-week rollout. Both go in writing.

transcript.speaker: Tara Singh
transcript.text: I'd want to pilot with our two busiest clinics first. If it works there it works anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: Agreed. Set up a full demo with Malik, our engineering director. If he's comfortable, we pilot.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: Full walkthrough today - intake routing, referral tracking, and the multi-site dashboard.

transcript.speaker: Malik Jones
transcript.text: Before you go further - how does patient data flow through your system? I need to know what's stored, where, and encrypted how.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: All PHI is encrypted at rest and in transit, US-only data residency, and I'll get you the full architecture doc. Our SE Sam can go as deep as you want on this.

transcript.speaker: Malik Jones
transcript.text: I'll want that session. EHR integration is the other big one - we're on Athena.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: Athena's a supported integration. I'll include the spec with the architecture doc.

transcript.speaker: Tara Singh
transcript.text: Can my coordinators see referral status across all clinics without switching views? That's the daily pain.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: One unified queue, filterable by clinic. Watch.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: I like what I'm seeing. What does the pilot look like commercially?

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: Four-week pilot on your two busiest clinics, flat fee, credited fully if you roll out.

transcript.speaker: Malik Jones
transcript.text: My comfort depends on the technical review. But nothing today scared me, which is rare.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: Let's do the pilot. Tara owns rollout, Malik owns the technical gate.

transcript.speaker: Tara Singh
transcript.text: Two weeks in: zero lost referrals across both pilot clinics. Normally we'd have dropped five or six by now. My coordinators are asking when the other clinics get it.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: That's the result I wanted to hear. Malik, where are you?

transcript.speaker: Malik Jones
transcript.text: Performance and the Athena sync have been solid. One flag: before full rollout, this goes through our formal security review. It's a real process, three-ish weeks, and I can't shortcut it.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: Understood. Send the questionnaire whenever, our compliance package is ready.

transcript.speaker: Malik Jones
transcript.text: There'll be a live architecture review too, my team plus whoever built your data layer. One walkthrough, deep questions.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Lee
transcript.text: We'll line up the right people on our side.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: Assuming security clears, I want full rollout before the fall clinic openings. Jordan, get us a full proposal in parallel so the review isn't blocking paper.

transcript.speaker: Elena Vasquez
transcript.text: Good milestone, everyone. Let's keep the pace.
